item.title: US life expectancy hit an all-time high in 2024, CDC says
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — U.S. life expectancy rose to 79 years in 2024 — the highest mark in American history. It’s the result of not only the dissipation of the COVID-19 pandemic, but also waning death rates from all the nation’s top killers, including heart disease, cancer and drug overdoses. item.title: Valley communities undergo 2026 Point-in-Time count for local homelessness numbers
item.description: The Maricopa Association of Governments and cities across the Valley conducted the 2026 Point-in-Time count this week to get an estimate on the number of local unsheltered and sheltered homeless populations.
